scope.summary: Add a compile+registration gate that admits a command to the contract only if it satisfies all four properties: (a) typed (schemars::JsonSchema input+output), (b) dry-runnable (preview returns the resulting StudioEditProposal diff without mutating authority), (c) receipted (non-dry-run emits an EventLedger receipt under a studio.* event_family with KernelActor attribution), (d) undoable (produces a StudioHistoryEntry, participates in per-file undo/redo). A command missing any property is not admissible.
acceptance_criteria: only four-property commands admitted; dry-run/receipt/undo enforced at registration
proof_targets: admissibility gate test + dry-run zero-mutation proof
expected_tests: test: registry rejects a command lacking any of the four properties
live: dry-run returns diff with zero authority mutation
test: non-dry-run emits actor-attributed receipt + history entry

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

target_entries: Studio / Automation / Command admissibility rules (model layer)

risk_if_missed: Non-admissible commands (no dry-run/receipt/undo) reach the contract; auditability + reversibility broken.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
